scenes.headline: What happens when a top-8 router fires 32 experts
scenes.sub: A6B: one routing constant changed, then healed with frozen-router deltas.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Topaz! A six B makes a mixture-of-experts router fire four times as many experts. Here's what breaks, and how it's healed.

scenes.label: The catch
scenes.text: Firing more experts adds no weights. But renormalization hands 54% of the gate mass to experts never trained to fire together.
scenes.say: Firing more experts adds no weights. But the gates are renormalized, so fifty-four percent of the mass lands on experts never trained together.

steps.say: Each layer holds two hundred and fifty-six experts. A softmax router scores every one of them for each token.
Stock, it keeps the top eight and renormalizes their weights to sum to one. About three billion parameters fire.
A six B keeps thirty-two instead. The sum is still one, so the newcomers take their weight from the trained eight.
It all sums with an always-on shared expert, so over half the output now comes from untrained combinations.

scenes.title: MMLU as only top-k changes
scenes.note: GSM8K falls at every step too
scenes.say: The damage is smooth: knowledge and math scores fall at every step. There's no lucky k to search for, so the model has to be healed.

items.say: Run the target corpus at top thirty-two, and count how often each expert fires.
Keep the ones carrying the work: eight hundred and thirty-three layer-experts.
Train delta tensors on just those experts. The router and everything else stay frozen.
Switch the deltas off, and you get the exact stock model back.

scenes.label: MMLU gap to base after the mixed healing run: a statistical tie
scenes.note: a repair, not a gain; healing saturates by ~38% of training
scenes.say: With a mixed corpus, the MMLU gap shrinks to a statistical tie: a repair, not a gain.

scenes.text: Renormalized top-k is not free to widen: the added experts take real gate mass the model never learned to share.

recap: Top-8 to top-32 adds compute, not weights
Renormalization moves 54% of mass to untrained experts
Frozen-router deltas heal it to a tie
scenes.say: To recap: four times the experts, no new weights, steady damage, and a patch that heals it to a tie.
